title: Hall complement numbers
summary: A positive integer $m$ is termed a \emph{Hall number} if every finite group $G$ whose order is precisely divisible by $m$ possesses a Hall subgroup of order $m$. Seeking generalizations of Sylow's theorem and Hall's theorem for finite solvable groups, Jiping Zhang asked for a full classification of Hall numbers, a problem recently solved by Guo, Hu and Li. Inspired by Zhang's problem, Guohua Qian put forward an analogous problem on a full classification of Hall complement numbers.
